citation.authors: BMJ Nutrition, Prevention and Health (retraction notice)

cited_by.title: Apple cider vinegar: weight, blood sugar and safety

record.population: Lebanese adolescents and young adults with overweight and obesity (a 2024 randomised trial of apple cider vinegar for weight)
record.design: Retraction notice for the 2024 randomised, double-blind trial in BMJ Nutrition, Prevention and Health
record.finding: BMJ Nutrition, Prevention and Health retracted its 2024 trial of apple cider vinegar for weight management in Lebanese young people. The notice I opened gives the DOI of the retracted article and no reasons in the part I read.
record.note: Included so no one quotes that trial as evidence. The original trial (PMID 38966098) is not counted in this entry.
